finalText:
All 625 tests pass now.

`orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` was computing tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, so it only broke rows where both a discount and a tax rate were non-zero (3 of 625 cases — everything else has a zero in one of those fields, which masked the bug). Fixed by applying the tax rate to `discounted` instead of `cents`.
